items.question: How long does sunlight need to get to Earth?
items.answer: Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth. [solar_system.pdf p.1]

items.question: How long is a year on Mercury?
items.answer: A year on Mercury lasts only 88 Earth days. [solar_system.pdf p.1]

items.question: Why is Venus so hot?
items.answer: Venus is so hot because its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat in a runaway greenhouse effect. [solar_system.pdf p.1]

items.question: How much of Earth's surface is covered by water?
items.answer: About 71 percent of Earth's surface is covered by water. [solar_system.pdf p.1]

items.question: Why does Mars look red?
items.answer: Mars looks red because iron oxide (rust) covers its surface. [solar_system.pdf p.1]

items.question: How high is Olympus Mons?
items.answer: Olympus Mons is about 22 kilometres high. [solar_system.pdf p.1]

items.question: How old is Jupiter's Great Red Spot?
items.answer: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a storm larger than Earth that has lasted for at least 350 years. [solar_system.pdf p.2]

items.question: Which moon is the biggest in the solar system?
items.answer: Ganymede is the largest moon in the solar system. [solar_system.pdf p.2]

items.question: What are Saturn's rings made of?
items.answer: Saturn's rings are made mostly of ice particles, with some rock and dust. [solar_system.pdf p.2]

items.question: Why does Uranus rotate on its side?
items.answer: Uranus rotates on its side, with an axial tilt of about 98 degrees, probably caused by a giant collision long ago. [solar_system.pdf p.2]

items.question: How fast are the winds on Neptune?
items.answer: The winds on Neptune reach more than 2,000 kilometres per hour. [solar_system.pdf p.2]

items.question: What is the largest object in the asteroid belt?
items.answer: The largest object in the asteroid belt is Ceres. [solar_system.pdf p.3]

items.question: When did Pluto stop being classified as a planet?
items.answer: Pluto was reclassified from a planet to a dwarf planet by the International Astronomical Union (IAU). [solar_system.pdf p.1]

items.question: When did Voyager 1 reach interstellar space?
items.answer: Voyager 1 entered interstellar space in 2012. [solar_system.pdf p.3]

items.question: What is the largest moon of Saturn?
items.answer: Ganymede is the largest moon in the solar system. [solar_system.pdf p.2]

items.answer: According to the context, the number of moons Saturn has is not explicitly stated.
